title: IncrementalElectricityPack (v1.0-current)
description: Structural validation schema for the IncrementalElectricityPack artefact family, v1.0-current layer only. This schema validates the fields the Edendale process-heat proof-of-concept repository actually produces today; it does NOT implement the manuscript's fuller aspirational schema (Sub-Module SM-3.5-A, Schema Version 1.0), which is tracked separately as a future v1.1-target schema, not yet created. The normative source for this artefact family is docs/03_artifact_contract_specification.qmd (revised); this schema is its machine-readable implementation. Any divergence discovered between this schema and that document is a defect requiring a decision-log entry and version update (docs/00b_phase1_decision_log.md), not a silent correction of either file. This schema implements structural validation only: required-field presence, type, controlled-vocabulary (enum/const) membership, and numeric bounds. It does NOT implement derivation checks (e.g. that peak_incremental_mw equals the maximum of the source hourly trace), foreign-key resolution (e.g. that run_id or future_id resolve to real registered records), or unit validation, all of which require an external validator not yet built (see docs/08_incremental_electricity_schema_specification_plan.qmd Section 6). additionalProperties is false: only the eleven required fields below and the three optional fields (validation_outcome, warning_codes, qualification_codes) are permitted; any other field causes validation to fail, per the authorisation decision in docs/08a_incremental_electricity_schema_authorisation.md Decision 1, as extended by docs/83 for the third optional field.

artefact_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this artefact instance. Assembled at construction time; no repository file currently assigns this value (docs/03 Section 5).

schema_version.description: Declares which contract layer this artefact instance conforms to. Fixed to 'v1.0-current'; an artefact declaring 'v1.1-target' should be validated against the separate, not-yet-created v1.1-target schema instead.

site_id.description: Identifies which site produced this artefact. Assembled; the current PoC is single-site, so exactly one value is currently registered. Widening this enum to add a further site is a backward-compatible schema revision (docs/08 Section 9).

run_id.description: Producing-run reference. Typed as a string (not UUID), matching the repository's human-readable run_manifest.json convention, e.g. '20260106_085759_epoch2035_demandpack_2035' (docs/03b Decision 1). No stricter pattern is enforced at this schema revision; see docs/08 Section 5 for the rationale and the note on this as a candidate future refinement. Unit: none (identifier).

future_id.description: FutureArtefact reference. Typed as an integer 0-63, matching FutureArtefact's own indexing (docs/03b Decision 2a). This bounds check independently catches some, but not all, unresolved future_id values; full foreign-key resolution against the registered FutureArtefact set requires an external validator (docs/08a Decision 2). Unit: none (identifier).

pathway_id.description: Identifies which pathway variant this artefact belongs to. Assembled from the repository's combined epoch_tag string (docs/03 Section 4).

epoch.description: Planning year. Assembled from the repository's combined epoch_tag string. Enumerated to the confirmed set of registered epochs rather than an open numeric range, so a mistyped or unregistered year is caught structurally (docs/08 Section 5). Unit: planning year.

annual_incremental_mwh.description: Total incremental electrical energy over the epoch year. Directly present under a different name and unit in repository output (annual_energy_GWh x 1000). Should reconcile with the hourly source trace sum x time-step; this reconciliation is a derivation check not enforced by this schema (docs/03 Section 7; docs/08 Section 6). Unit: MWh.

peak_incremental_mw.description: Maximum hourly incremental load over the epoch year. Directly present under a different name in repository output (peak_MW). Must equal the maximum of the source hourly trace; this derivation check is not enforced by this schema and requires an external validator (docs/03 Section 7; docs/08 Section 6). Unit: MW.

p95_incremental_mw.description: 95th-percentile hourly incremental load over the epoch year. Directly present under a different name in repository output (p95_MW). Must equal the 95th percentile of the source hourly trace; this derivation check is not enforced by this schema and requires an external validator. Should never exceed peak_incremental_mw; this cross-field constraint is not expressible in this schema and is noted here for implementers only (docs/03 Section 7; docs/08 Section 5, Section 6). Unit: MW.

validation_outcome.description: Optional. Result of the most recent gate-execution run against this artefact instance, per the framework-wide vocabulary (docs/04 Section 6). Not required at v1.0-current. The current generator (`tools/build_incremental_electricity_pack_anchor21_from_real_outputs.py`) populates this field with a fixed value of `'manual_review_required'` on every instance it produces (docs/29 Section 6), reflecting that these artefacts have not passed a full automated validation-gate pass — not the result of any content-dependent evaluation. No producing module currently varies this value by artefact content or executes a full gate-execution pass. Distinct from `lifecycle_status`, which is not part of the v1.0-current schema at all (docs/04 Section 5; docs/03 Section 5 Group A).

warning_codes.description: Optional. Controlled-vocabulary list of specific, named, non-blocking shortfalls attached when validation_outcome is 'pass_with_warning' (docs/04 Section 7; docs/04a_validation_vocabulary_table.csv). Restricted to the subset of the global and family-specific warning-code vocabulary applicable to IncrementalElectricityPack (docs/08 Section 7). Not required at v1.0-current. uniqueItems: true prevents the same warning code being listed more than once on a single artefact instance.

qualification_codes.description: Optional. Controlled-vocabulary list of qualification-stage findings about this artefact instance -- statements about what a downstream consumer needs to know before using specific declared field values for a particular decision. Distinct from validation_outcome/warning_codes, which report validation-stage gate-execution results (docs/04 Section 6-7) and are not required to hold any particular value for a qualification code to be present or absent here; also distinct from schema-structural conformity and trace-evidential validity, neither of which this field speaks to. Not required at v1.0-current. uniqueItems: true prevents the same qualification code being listed more than once on a single artefact instance. See docs/81, docs/82, docs/83 for the governance rationale and the closed vocabulary's current single member and its meaning.
